portfolioScreens.scope: Recorded changes within the {n} projects in this filtered Portfolio
portfolioScreens.window: From {from} through the server read time
portfolioScreens.ceiling: This Portfolio has reached its 5,000-project read limit. Changes describe only the returned projects; refine the filters for a smaller scope.
portfolioScreens.historyUnavailable: Some history is unavailable. Confirmed moves remain listed; missing history is not counted as zero.
portfolioScreens.coverage: Projects with incomplete history: {n}. This list contains only confirmed moves from available records.
portfolioScreens.noConfirmed: No project moves are confirmed in the available records for this scope and window
portfolioScreens.healthDefinition: A project appears once when its recorded daily computed-health readings or current computed health differ. Daily samples do not reconstruct every change within a day. An exact total needs each daily reading and the current state.
portfolioScreens.milestonesDefinition: A milestone counts once when the activity log records an existing date moving later. Repeated slips of the same milestone count once; setting or clearing a date does not count. The list names the projects containing those milestones.
portfolioScreens.statusDefinition: A project counts once when the activity log records a change from one lifecycle status to another in this window
